svg.text: How do I get a fire going?
OFFLINE GUIDE · MAKING A FIRE · INSTANT, NO LLM
Clear a circle to bare dirt, away from branches.
Tiny dry twigs first, then pencil-thick sticks.
Keep it small. Drown it and stir until cold.
I only have damp matches. What else works?
Check your kit for a lighter or a ferro
rod first. Damp matches can still work:
dry them inside your clothes for a few
minutes, then strike on a dry rock.
